meta.title: Pay your students' fees
meta.description: Pay every waiting student's competition fee in one payment.

pay.title: Pay fees
pay.lead: Pay for every student who is waiting in one payment. Each one is confirmed, with a registration number, as soon as the payment comes through.
pay.freeBody: This competition is free, so there is nothing to pay. Confirm your students to give each one a registration number.
pay.confirmFree: Confirm {count, plural, one {# student} other {# students}}
pay.confirmedFree: {count, plural, one {# student is} other {# students are}} confirmed.

noInstitution.title: There is nothing to pay here
noInstitution.body: This page is for the coordinators and the authorised person of an institution. Ask your institution's authorised person to invite you as a coordinator.

notFound.title: We couldn't find that registration
notFound.body: Your institution has no registration with that reference. Open it from the competitions page instead.

nothingToPay.title: No fees are waiting
nothingToPay.body: Every student in this registration is paid for. Add a student, and their fee shows up here.

feeNotSet.title: The fee isn't set yet
feeNotSet.body: Friends of Animals hasn't set this competition's fee for institutions yet. Come back once it is announced.

error.institution_not_verified: Your institution isn't verified at the moment, so fees can't be paid.
error.nothing_to_pay: No student is waiting for their fee any more.
error.fee_not_set: This competition's fee isn't set yet, so nothing can be paid.
error.gateway_unavailable: The payment service isn't answering. Nothing was charged. Try again in a few minutes.
error.superseded: Someone else at your institution is paying at the same time. Wait a minute, then reload this page.
error.not_found: We couldn't find that payment. Reload this page and try again.
error.invalid_signature: We couldn't confirm that payment. If money left your account, it is confirmed as soon as the payment service tells us.
error.confirm_failed: We couldn't check your payment just now. If money left your account, it is confirmed as soon as the payment service tells us.
error.checkout_unavailable: The payment window couldn't open. Check your connection and try again.
error.payment_failed: The payment didn't go through, so nothing was charged. You can try again.
error.forbidden: You can't pay for this institution any more.
error.failed: Something went wrong. Nothing was charged. Try again.

testCheckout.title: Test checkout
testCheckout.body: This is a test payment: no money moves. Razorpay's checkout takes this place once its keys are set.
testCheckout.unavailable: The test checkout is off here.

meta.title: Your payment
meta.description: A fee payment and the students it confirms.

statusBody.created: This payment is still being set up.
statusBody.order_created: We haven't received this payment yet. If you have paid, your students are confirmed as soon as the payment service tells us.
statusBody.captured: Paid on {date}. Each student below is confirmed.
statusBody.failed: The payment service couldn't start this payment, so nothing was charged.
statusBody.cancelled: A newer payment replaced this one before anything was paid.
